details.name: Free Download Manager
details.who: All Firefox users who have installed version 1.5.7.5 of the Free Download Manager extension.
details.why: Version 1.5.7.5 of the Free Download Manager extension is causing frequent crashes in recent versions of Firefox. Version 1.5.7.6 corrects this problem, but it is currently not available on addons.mozilla.org. We recommend all users to update to the new version once it becomes available.
